subject: Re: Request: Audit window & evidence for DPA / DPIA support
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@bridgecloud.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: gdpr@bridgecloud.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: DPA audit window + DPIA artifacts for cross-border transfers

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this — BridgeCloud's legal/privacy team is running a compliance push ahead of our EU expansion and we need to validate a short list of vendor controls. Specifically, we need:

- A current Art. 28 subprocessor list (production + backup vendors)
- Redacted Art. 30 processing ledger for the Redwood service that covers EU data subjects
- A DPIA summary or risk treatment document relating to cross-border transfers and profiling (if applicable)
- Latest SOC 2 Type II or equivalent control report

Can Redwood support a remote audit/review the week of Sep 20? If possible we'd like a consolidated archive (redacted ledger + DPIA summary + SOC2) uploaded to our secure intake site and a 90-minute review call with technical folks.

I'm attaching our due-diligence checklist (BridgeCloud_DueDiligence_Request.pdf).

Best,
Sophie Lang
Head of Third-Party Risk | BridgeCloud
S: +44 20 7123 4567

From: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@bridgecloud.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: DPA audit window + DPIA artifacts for cross-border transfers

Hi Sophie — and thanks for the checklist.

Quick summary of what we can provide immediately:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Q2_2026.pdf (full report under NDA)
- redwood_subprocessor_list_20260904.csv (production + scheduled rotations)
- redwood_art30_ledger_redacted_20260904.pdf (redacted to remove customer IDs)
- dpia-summary-redwood-2026.pdf (executive summary + key mitigations)

We can upload the consolidated archive to your secure intake (please confirm SFTP/Drive preference) and do a remote review the week of Sep 20.

For the remote review we propose: 90-minute session split 45/45 for legal/compliance review and technical Q&A, with a short 15-min alignment beforehand. If BridgeCloud requires an on-site inspection we will need to coordinate security onboarding (badge access, NDA, limited scope).

A couple of asks on our side:
1) Please confirm the audit scope (only inference runtime and telemetry? or also ingestion pipelines and support logs?)
2) Any specific fields you will need redacted (IPs, customer names, PII samples, etc.) beyond our standard redaction policy.

Attaching the SOC2 and current subprocessor list for intake reference. I will loop in our infra lead for the technical artifacts.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Q2_2026.pdf; redwood_subprocessor_list_20260904.csv

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@bridgecloud.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: DPA audit window + DPIA artifacts for cross-border transfers

Hi Sophie — looping in procurement to ensure any audit access and NDAs are handled quickly. Two notes from contracting:

- Our standard DPA already includes an audit clause (Art. X) that supports remote reviews and documentation access; if BridgeCloud needs additional in-person audit rights we can do an addendum but it requires 30 days' notice.
- For speed, could you confirm whether BridgeCloud will be submitting a PO or going via a procurement portal? We can also attach a short mutual action plan (MAP) to the intake packet.

Link to proposed MAP / intake tracker: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AAbcExampleDriveLink
DocuSign (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/envelope/XYZ789-example

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@bridgecloud.com>, rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: DPA audit window + DPIA artifacts for cross-border transfers

Hi all — technical artifacts to support the DPIA / Art. 28 / transfer questions. Summary below; full files attached.

What you'll find in the attachments:
- kv-cache-ops-diagram.png — architecture diagram showing ephemeral KV cache split and TTLs for session tokens (no customer PII in diagram)
- data-flow-eu-us-2026.pdf — redacted data flow map for EU-region tenants, includes SCC-classified transfer legs and pseudonymisation points
- kms-rotation-notes.txt — summary of KMS rotation schedule, envelope encryption model, and HSM integration notes
- redwood_art30_ledger_redacted_20260904.pdf (already shared by Rafael)

A few clarifications:
- Transfers to US compute for model inference occur only after pseudonymisation and are minimized by routing EU traffic to EU Dedicated pools when available.
- We rotate KEKs quarterly; CMKs are rotated annually with emergency rotation procedures documented in the attached notes.
- We can provide timeboxed log extracts for the remote review; live telemetry access would require a scoped NDA.

If the BridgeCloud team wants a dedicated technical walkthrough, we can do a 45-minute session during the week of Sep 20.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
Attachments: kv-cache-ops-diagram.png; data-flow-eu-us-2026.pdf; kms-rotation-notes.txt

From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@bridgecloud.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: gdpr@bridgecloud.com
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: DPA audit window + DPIA artifacts for cross-border transfers

Thanks Rafael, Marissa, Karthik — this looks good.

We can do a remote audit on Sep 22 (legal + compliance) and Sep 23 (technical) — please confirm availability and whether you can provide a single ZIP with: redacted Art.30 ledger, DPIA summary, SOC2, and the data-flow map. We will use that ZIP for our intake and not share externally.

Please also confirm whether BridgeCloud will need an executed NDA before you upload the archive (we can sign one immediately if required).

Regards,
Sophie Lang
Head of Third-Party Risk | BridgeCloud
Attachments: BridgeCloud_DueDiligence_Request.pdf (received)
